info.name: Amika API — v0beta1 API keys SandboxSnapshots API
List sandbox-captured snapshots for the caller's org

params.name: repository_id
params.description: If set, only return snapshots taken from sandboxes attached to this repository.

params.name: source_sandbox_id
params.description: If set, only return snapshots captured from this sandbox.

items.docs: List sandbox-captured snapshots for the caller's org

info.name: Start capturing a snapshot from a running sandbox

items.docs: Validates the request, records a snapshot in the `capturing` state, and runs the (slow) Daytona capture in the background. Returns 202 immediately; poll the listing for the row to reach `active`/`failed`.

info.name: Preview which injected secrets a 'snapshot and delete' would remove

params.name: sandbox
params.description: The sandbox whose injected secrets would be scrubbed.

params.name: by
params.description: How to interpret `sandbox`: name (default), id, or ref/name_or_id (matches either; rejects ambiguity).

items.docs: Preview which injected secrets a 'snapshot and delete' would remove

info.name: Read a sandbox snapshot by name (default) or id

params.name: ref
params.description: Snapshot reference: its fully-qualified name (default) or row id. Use the `by` query param to choose.

params.name: by
params.description: How to interpret the reference: name (default), id, or ref/name_or_id (matches either; rejects ambiguity).
